patrolWindow.note: D41: an objective can only be worked while no patrol is within this radius. Waiting for the window is the decision that fills the minutes.

note_contested: S16 8g. A contested contract goes to several Firms at once and pays a premium for it: better money, and someone else is coming. Deliberately a MINORITY — if most work were contested the board would stop being a choice and every sortie would be a race. The premium is what makes taking one a decision rather than a trap.
note_defend:
S16 8j / D49a. The one INBOUND contract: you are stationary and something comes to you. Being SEEN is not failure here — you are meant to be there — which is why it has no stealth clause at all. Tier 2 because it needs rivals who actually arrive (8g/8i).
REWARD IS DERIVED, NOT FELT. It was 240 by guesswork when the type was added, while every other type had been effort-priced — 0.133 reward per work-tick against a family median of 0.0767, and the battery duly read it 4.85x over-chosen. It is now the family rate (0.0767 x 1800 = 138) times the project's existing contested premium (contested.rewardPct 150), because a Defend is contested by definition: 207. This is NOT the reward cut D42 forbids — D42 protects types that were already effort-priced. This one never was; this is that pass, applied late.
